results.correct_value: Class 4 (short loose Class 4 cliff above the high col; Class 2-3 on the southeast summit ridge)
results.evidence: A 2021 trip report of this exact line says the climbing was never more than Class 4 but was the diciest moves in years, on a chossy steep-to-overhanging cliff above the col, with Class 2-3 on the summit ridge. An independent guided-traverse report says the receded Christie Glacier forces climbers onto 4th class rock to reach the summit ridge. Grade raised to Class 4; the skills and exposure cards now mention the Class 4 step; grade_num is derived and left alone.

results.evidence: One report crossed the moat to the col and then faced a chossy, eroded, steep-to-overhanging cliff, and on descent made one rappel down to the col. Both place the crux above the col, below the krummholz, not at the summit.
